problem: An upstream-writer R12/R14 layer lineweight refusal returned false with no useful filter error, while the save UI attributed the failure to filename or permissions.
change: On the first failed DXF layer write to R12/R14 with non-default lineweight, retain a translated message naming the layer and offering a newer format or default lineweight. Return it in lastError and exportReport; clear it at the next non-reentrant export or import and when protecting an original recovery source. The existing save failure path shows the export report when available.
validation: Modified incremental macOS LibreCAD linked to installed upstream passes the [ltype]~[dwg] selector: 17/17 cases, 3991 assertions.

R12 and R14 failure controls run through RS_FileIO: each preserves destination and caller pen, reports the exact layer, and permits a subsequent successful export with a default lineweight, without stale report. Direct filter retry and fresh R12 reimport also pass.
The modified filter, test and application-window translation units compile with the bundled-codec headers.
The patch applies cleanly after the existing 13 patches at pinned LibreCAD master. No generated DWG or DXF fixture is committed.
limits: The focused runtime uses a modified incremental macOS upstream-linked LibreCAD build; GUI display and actual bundled runtime are not independently tested by this receipt. A separate clean bundled application build is in progress. The diagnostic is scoped to the observed legacy layer-lineweight failure and does not claim to explain every refusal. The downstream patch remains unmerged; no format claim or phase gate is promoted.
